meta.source: Official Wheel of Destiny planner (test.tibia.com), WASM module run in Node + SkillwheelStringsJsonLibrary.json; reference builds and target counts from community data.
meta.note: Facts derived by running the planner; no CipSoft code is included.

unlockGraph.rule: A slice can receive points when unlocked; a slice unlocks the listed slices once completely filled. Identical for all vocations.

revelation.rule: Stage = highest threshold reached by domain points (+ Revelation Mastery). Flat damage & healing bonus = sum over the 4 domains of bonusPerStage[stage].

revelationMastery.rule: Each filled Revelation Mastery slice adds its points to the revelation of its own domain. Supreme RM mods add their grade value to the named revelation (planner shows grade IV = +225). Both count toward thresholds only, not toward grid capacity.

augmentStacking.rule: Each augmentation conviction exists on two slices. Filling one copy grants stage I, the second copy adds stage II (cumulative), independent of fill order.

vessels.rule: Vessel n (0-based) unlocks when n+1 Gem Vessel slices are completely filled, regardless of which ones. Each filled Gem Vessel slice also gives +1 flat damage & healing.
vessels.vesselModsByQuality: Lesser vessel activates basic mod 1; regular vessel basic 1+2; greater vessel basic 1+2+supreme.

momentum.rule: Increasing the mod grade of cooldown augmentations does not further reduce the cooldown of spells, but adds a chance to gain Momentum that is additive to other chances of gaining Momentum. Applies to supreme cooldown augment mods; additive across gems.

texts.conviction:
The Conviction Perk is unlocked when the maximum number of promotion points for this slice has been assigned.

Most Conviction Perks can be found more than once within the Wheel of Destiny. When they are unlocked, their effect adds up.
texts.augmentation:
The Conviction Perk is unlocked when the maximum number of promotion points for this slice has been assigned.

There are always two identical Augmentations within the Wheel of Destiny. Regardless of the order of unlocking, bonus I will always be available before bonus II.
texts.revelation:
To unlock a Revelation Perk, you need to distribute promotion points in the corresponding domain.

To unlock stage 1 of a Revelation Perk, you need 250 promotion points. Stage 2 requires 500 promotion points. As soon as you have distributed 1000 promotion points, stage 3 is unlocked.

Revelation Mastery, which can be found on some gems, provides additional points to unlock Revelation Perks.

Unlocked Revelation Perks grant a bonus to all damage and healing:
- Stage 1 grants a bonus of +4 damage and healing

- Stage 2 increases this bonus to +9

- Stage 3 increases this bonus to +20
texts.gems:
Gems can be revealed within the Gem Atelier. Different gem qualities yield different amounts of mods:
- Lesser gem: one basic mod

- Regular gem: two basic mods

- Greater gem: two basic mods and one supreme mod

You can enhance the effects of a mod by increasing its grade in the Fragment Workshop.
texts.cooldownLimit: Note: The cooldown of a spell cannot be reduced to less than 50% of its base cooldown by any means.

revelations.name: Gift of Life
revelations.shortInfo: Allows you to survive an otherwise fatal blow.
revelations.description:
If an attack (except with agony damage) were to kill you but the overkill damage amounts to less than 20%/25%/30% of your maximum hit points, you will heal yourself for 20%/25%/30% of your maximum hit points. Only after that is the damage applied.

In addition, all your spell cooldowns are reduced by 60 seconds, and 20%/25%/30% of your maximum mana is restored.

Cooldown: 30h/20h/10h

The cooldown is only reduced while the character has a battle sign.

revelations.name: Gift of Life
revelations.shortInfo: Allows you to survive an otherwise fatal blow.
revelations.description:
If an attack (except with agony damage) were to kill you but the overkill damage amounts to less than 20%/25%/30% of your maximum hit points, you will heal yourself for 20%/25%/30% of your maximum hit points. Only after that is the damage applied.

In addition, all your spell cooldowns are reduced by 60 seconds, and 20%/25%/30% of your maximum mana is restored.

Cooldown: 30h/20h/10h

The cooldown is only reduced while the character has a battle sign.
